headline: Executive order closes federal executive departments and agencies on December 24 and December 26, 2025.
what_it_does: This order closes executive departments and agencies of the federal government on Wednesday, December 24, 2025, and Friday, December 26, 2025, the days before and after Christmas. Orders like this usually give most federal workers those days off, while letting agency heads keep some offices open for national security, defense, or other public needs. No summary was provided, so details such as exceptions come from the title and past practice, not this order's text.

who_it_affects.how: Most federal workers in executive agencies would get December 24 and December 26, 2025, off work.

who_it_affects.group: People who use federal offices and services
who_it_affects.how: Some in-person federal services may be closed or limited on those two days.
